item.title: Rio the Hero!
item.description:
An inspired Rio Ngumoha led an extraordinary comeback at Anfield, as Liverpool overcame a 2-0 deficit to win 4-3 against Villareal in the Champions League. The results makes it 3 wins from 3 in this season's UCL for the Reds.

On the agenda:

00:00 Intro

04:12 Rio's second-half masterclass

31:45 What changed at half-time?

1:02:30 Brighton preview


YNWA!!

KOP ON YOUTUBE: ➡️ ⁠https://www.youtube.com/c/koponpodcast⁠

“Kop On!” is a podcast dedicated to the worldwide LFC Family 🌍, for supporters everywhere.
